pages.title: Privacy Policy — Barakode Technologies
pages.metaDescription: How Barakode Technologies collects, uses, and protects personal information in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
pages.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy outlines how Barakode Technologies collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you interact with our website and services. We are committed to handling your data with care, transparency, and in full compliance with applicable data protection laws.

policySections.title: Information We Collect
policySections.body: We collect personal information you voluntarily provide when interacting with our services, including your name, email address, phone number, and company details. This includes data submitted through contact forms, project inquiry submissions, and newsletter signups. We also automatically gather non-personal data such as browser type, device information, and usage statistics through cookies and analytics tools.

policySections.title: How We Use Your Information
policySections.body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services. This includes responding to project inquiries, processing service requests, personalizing user experiences, and delivering updates you have opted into. We may also use your data to analyze website performance, detect fraudulent activity, and maintain platform security.

policySections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
policySections.body: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and better understand user behavior. Cookies are small data files stored on your device that help remember your preferences and session activity. Some cookies are essential for core site functionality, while others allow us to analyze performance and personalize content.

policySections.title: Your Rights and Choices
policySections.body: You have full control over your personal information and how it is used. You may request access to the data we hold, ask for corrections, or request complete deletion of your personal details at any time. If you no longer wish to receive communications from us, you can unsubscribe using the link provided in any of our emails.
